captions.detailed: A street pole CCTV mast featuring a square concrete anchor base with mounting bolts, a tapered round steel pole, and a side-arm bracket attached via a clamp collar at the top. At the tip of the arm, a black bullet-style security camera is mounted on a dual-axis knuckle yoke. The camera head can pan on a vertical revolute joint and tilt up or down on a horizontal revolute joint.
captions.instruction: Create a CadQuery model of a street pole CCTV mast. It should feature a square concrete base with bolts, a tall tapered steel pole, a side-arm bracket clamped near the top, and a black bullet camera on a jointed knuckle yoke that supports panning and tilting motions.
captions.factory: Construct a square box for the concrete anchor base and add small cylinders for the mounting bolts. Create a tapered vertical pole using a loft or a series of cylinders, adding a circular flange at its base. Model the top collar clamp using boolean subtractions on a cylinder, and extend a horizontal cylinder to form the side arm with a small diagonal support strut. Build the camera yoke using a vertical pin cylinder connected to a U-shaped bracket, and construct the camera body from a rectangular box with a cylindrical lens snout. Define revolute joints for the pan axis (vertical pin) and the tilt axis (horizontal yoke connection).
